purpose: Machine-readable SAC Story CSS support reference for automated CSS composition.
globalCaveat: CSS customizations take higher priority over other styling settings and may override the existing ones. Colors set via CSS may override specific color rules, such as threshold colors in charts. Widgets may not be adaptive to font sizes set via CSS, which results in text truncation.
